attempts.exactPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Create one premium realistic painterly raster character concept for the manifest-bound target "affinity-expansion-v1-crystal-guardian-wind".

Subject and threat:
- Species: crystal-guardian.
- Threat presentation tier: standard; reference Grade 4; canonical Grade not assigned.
- Battlefield duty: crystal-guardian-duty.
- Construction mode: constructed-humanoid.

Identity invariants:
- Crystal Guardian remains immediately recognizable
- Battlefield duty remains Reflective magic boss
- faceted reflective construct organized around one exposed refracting core
- Signature skills remain visually supportable: Refraction, Core beam, Shard field.
- Counterplay remains visible: The still image preserves readable counterplay for Spell control, Damage typing, Core targeting.

Anatomy invariants:
- exactly two articulated arms and two load-bearing legs
- one coherent controlling core with credible manufactured joints and ground contact

Affinity: wind.
Affinity expression: directional fur or cloth, vapor channels, debris flow, and pressure distortion with visible force
Counterplay cue: The still image preserves readable counterplay for Spell control, Damage typing, Core targeting. The still center of the pressure pattern remains visible between directional attacks.
Altered dimensions: silhouette; motion; attack-telegraph; environmental-wake.
Permitted transformations: silhouette; motion; attack telegraph; environmental wake.
Prohibited traits: living human anatomy; decorative affinity coating; extra or missing limbs; a pale recolor, transparency alone, or effects with no directional force.

Presentation:
- Style: Pack 2 premium realistic painterly dark fantasy with coherent materials, controlled linework, grounded anatomy, distinct species identity, and restrained local magical emission.
- Medium: premium realistic painterly raster creature concept.
- Background: neutral cracked-stone floor against a charcoal-to-midnight backdrop.
- Lighting: controlled neutral key with restrained local affinity emission and readable materials.
- Composition: Exactly one subject; entire creature, equipment, wings, tail, and every extremity visible, centered with finished detail across the canvas.
- Canvas: 1536 x 1024 image/png with at least 8 percent safe margin around the entire silhouette and all extremities.
- Framing lock: fit every hard extent—including weapon tip, standard, horns, tail, and effect wake—inside the central 84 percent of both canvas dimensions; leave a clearly empty border on all four sides.

Reference routing, in supplied order:
1. assets/enemies/review/constructs-v1.webp — Subject 4 only: Crystal Guardian identity, anatomy, duty silhouette, and material language; do not transfer another family member.
2. assets/enemies/review/pack-2/monster-grade-escalation-v1.png — Pack 2 realistic dark-fantasy finish, neutral presentation, material fidelity, and restrained emission only; do not transfer another species, anatomy, weapon, or scale.

Constraints:
- No labels, text, UI, frame, logo, or watermark.
- No extra creature, duplicate body, cropped extremity, blank band, unfinished region, or abrupt canvas cutoff.
- No resemblance to a published character or reference person.
- No sexualized anatomy, costume, or pose.
